resources.string: Cactus Whistle transcribes English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, and Polish on this device. Other languages use Android’s system recognizer.
Whistle runs speech recognition entirely on this device. The 16.9 MB model supports English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, and Polish. Other languages use Android’s system recognizer.
Download the Whistle model before using offline dictation.
Whistle is ready. Audio is processed on this device and is not uploaded.
